cases.scenario: A sync writes records with a stable source ID into a table with a unique constraint and uses an upsert that replaces only the matching record. Replaying the same batch yields the same final rows.
A worker writes a durable row, then crashes before acknowledging the queue message. The message is redelivered and the worker repeats the operation using the same idempotency key.
A refresh job deletes all current rows, fetches replacement data, and then inserts it. Tests cover only successful runs. A provider timeout after deletion leaves the authoritative table empty.
A command reads authoritative state, computes a report in memory, and performs no writes or external side effects.
A batch processor advances its checkpoint before sending an external notification. A crash after checkpoint advancement but before the send causes restart logic to skip the notification permanently.
